🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector strength (10/11) and mixed risk signals with SPY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY alongside TLT (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -4.01% | 1M: -14.70%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit modestly improved: HYG (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.55%) ABOVE TREND → flat; corporates LQD (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND → flat.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-easing: UUP (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +1.60%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND indicate stable real-money demand with no clear tightening impulse.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Semis and momentum leading: SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) ABOVE TREND; Cyclicals/Financials also strong: Financials (XLF proxy) (1W: +2.89% | 1M: +5.54%) ABOVE TREND — style mixed, momentum plus cyclicals.

5. US vs Global?
US mixed: SPY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY while EM leads on the week: EEM (1W: +5.09% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -7.76%) RECOVERY — global participation present but variable.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation showing pockets of risk-on: IWM (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +3.64%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +5.57% | 1M: -20.12%) RECOVERY; ARKK (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -3.07%) RECOVERY signals selective speculative re-entry.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial metals recovering: CPER (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%) RECOVERY. Precious metals weak: GLD (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -22.76%) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy remains soft: XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND, while natural gas UNG (1W: -2.74% | 1M: +3.37%) CORRECTION — watch downside pressure in oil.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Semis/momentum (SOXX, QQQ) and small caps (IWM) showing consistent 1W/1M strength. DIVERGENCE: several industry names (CIBR (1W: -1.58% | 1M: +12.50%) CORRECTION, SKYY (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +6.69%) CORRECTION) reflect short-term rotation within sectors.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to semiconductors and small-cap/financial exposures showing strength; reduce exposure to weak energy and precious-metals exposures (GLD, BNO) until trends reassert.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Semiconductors SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND; Small caps IWM (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +3.64%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND; Brent BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper CPER (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%) RECOVERY as a cyclical signal. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) BELOW TREND and Silver SLV (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -22.76%) BELOW TREND on continued profit taking.

13. Key Levels?
VXX (1W: -4.01% | 1M: -14.70%) watch ~20 for complacency; HYG (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.55%) vs LQD (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +0.74%) ratio ~0.80 for credit health; XLK (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) vs XLF (1W: +2.89% | 1M: +5.54%) spread to monitor leadership shifts.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Semiconductors and small caps (SOXX 1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86% ABOVE TREND; IWM 1W: +4.01% | 1M: +3.64% ABOVE TREND) showing strength while energy and precious metals (BNO 1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38% BELOW TREND; GLD 1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21% BELOW TREND) are key divergences to monitor.
